title: spatialscape: a static, reactive browser for spatial transcriptomics and snRNA-seq
description: One Python package: a command-line tool that turns AnnData, SpatialData or SpatialExperiment objects into bundles of static files, and the web viewer that streams them. Every section of a study on one canvas, a gene switch as one range request, lasso selections and region tests in the browser; no server. The example datasets and the scripts that build them are in the spatialscape-examples repository.
